# N-004 time zones + r61 TLS 1.2 (15.10.2026, W-NET)

## Time zones (r20, N-004)
* `lib/tz/tz.fi` (pure arithmetic) + `lib/tz/zonedata.fi` (GENERATED by `tools/tz/gen.py` from IANA tzdata):
  79 zones in 8 regions, each = standard offset (signed minutes) + rule `0 none, 1 EU, 2 US/CA, 3 AU, 4 NZ`.
  `gen.py` classifies every candidate against the rules for 2024..2040 and REFUSES what no rule reproduces
  (Santiago, Havana, Jerusalem, Cairo, Casablanca are not in the table).
* Kernel (`kernel/sched/time.fi`): standard offset = magnitude + west flag (`base_w()` = wrapped signed minutes);
  `SYS_OSUM_SETTZ(minutes, rule | west<<8)`; `I_TZRULE` returns `rule | west<<8`; `I_TZBASE` the magnitude.
  Boot line: `tz=-300` and `tzrule=eu|us|au|nz`.
* `/etc/time.conf`: `offset=-300`, `rule=eu|us|au|nz|none`, `zone=<city>` (sntp applies offset + rule; settings reads `zone=`).
* Settings > Time: region choice (K_CZ, key 64) + city choice (K_CZC, key 99). No settingsd key was added -> `keys=N` unchanged.
* File times in the explorer (`expmodell.zone_minutes_at`) use the same library, so a file from July in New York shows -4 h.
* Gate: `bash tools/tz/run.sh` (host): 79 zones x ~4.1 M instants = IANA; changeover seconds exact; negative controls.
* HONEST: only today's law (no history before the rule change), no zones whose rule is not one of the four.
  `wlibc` auto-dark and `taskbar` fallback still read only the non-negative offset of `time.conf`.

## TLS 1.2 (r61)
* Firn already had a TLS 1.2 client (`docs/TLS12.md` in Firn, commit 2ffb0d67d); the Firn PIN of OrientOS does not.
  Instead of moving the pin, `lib/tls/{tls,prf12,tls_main}.fi` were taken from Firn head and adapted:
  `net.read_nb/write_nb` -> `net.read/write` (the pin has no non-blocking net; `nb` mode is never switched on),
  `#[no_gc]` lines removed (pin compiler); `lib/std/crypto/{aes,gcm,hmac}.fi` from Firn head (AES-256), `accel.fi` =
  pin + `aes256_ni_encrypt_block`.
* Suites: ECDHE-ECDSA/RSA with AES-128/256-GCM and ChaCha20-Poly1305, X25519 + P-256, extended master secret.
* Gate: `bash tools/tls12/run.sh` (host, ~6 min, under heavy): 58 checks passed, 0 failed, 1 skipped (G non-blocking).
* NOT measured in a guest: `kernel/app/fetch.fi` (the ring-3 user of lib/tls) compiled? see report; the hwnet/tls.sh
  gate (QEMU) was not run.
* r23 key update: not measured (needs a TLS 1.3 key-update server; Firn's `tls_server.fi` does it, not ported).
